title: Segment customers with a single query
brief: Given the `orders` and `customers` tables, write one SQL query that returns the top 10 customers by total spend in the last 90 days, with their order count. Explain your joins in two sentences.

rubric.name: Correctness
rubric.description: Query returns the right rows and columns for the stated question.

rubric.name: Join reasoning
rubric.description: Joins are appropriate and the written explanation is accurate.

rubric.name: Readability
rubric.description: Aliases, formatting and filtering are clear and idiomatic.

title: Build an accessible filter list
brief: Build a React component that renders a list of items with a text filter. The input must be labelled, results must announce their count to screen readers, and the empty state must name the next action.

rubric.name: Component design
rubric.description: State and props are modelled cleanly; no unnecessary re-renders.

rubric.name: Accessibility
rubric.description: Labelling, focus handling and live-region announcements are correct.

rubric.name: Empty state
rubric.description: The zero-results state is designed and names the next action.
